# Code-to-Visual Interpreter

> Bidirectional bridge between visual design and code.

**Category:** Creative Development · **Tier:** Professional

## Overview

Translates between visual geometry and underlying code structure in both directions, producing assets that stay lean instead of bloated.

## Target audience

Creative technologists and web developers.

**The pain it solves:** Handoff between design tools and code is lossy and slow; auto-generated assets are typically bloated and unmaintainable.

## Skill required to leverage it

Computational Design — users must understand the relationship between visual geometry and the underlying code structure to prevent the plugin from creating bloated or unoptimized assets.

## Monetization

Developer-tool subscription with a free tier; team plans for agencies doing interactive work.

## Roadmap

- [ ] SVG/canvas ↔ code round-tripping
- [ ] Asset weight budget warnings
- [ ] Framework targets (vanilla, React, Three.js)
